sections.section_title: GPIO port bit set/reset register (GPIOx_BSRR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)
sections.text_helper: Section 8.5.7 "GPIO port bit set/reset register (GPIOx_BSRR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)" in chapter 8 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 191.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x18
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 BRy: Port x reset I/O y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are write-only. A read operation always returns 0x0000.
0: No action on the corresponding ODRx bit
1: Resets the corresponding ODRx bit
Note: If both BSx and BRx are set, BSx has priority.
Bits 15:0 BSy: Port x set I/O y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are write-only. A read operation always returns 0x0000.
0: No action on the corresponding ODRx bit
1: Sets the corresponding ODRx bit
